nodes.summary: Damped KKL inequality under the Bernoulli(`p`) measure, `0 < p < 1`: with `A = 4p(1-p)`, `2 · (∑_{S ≠ ∅} (A^{|S|-1} / A) f̂(S)²) · log (1 / maxₑ Infₑ) ≤ ∑ₑ Infₑ`.
nodes.title: Damped KKL inequality under the $p$-biased measure

nodes.summary: Integrating the damped total-influence weights over the noise parameter, with the `p`-biased scaling `A = 4p(1-p)`.

nodes.summary: The KKL inequality with constant `2` at `p = 1/2`, obtained from `fpe_dampedVarLogGain`. The same statement is `kkl_inequality_total fsr_pbiased_endpoint`, proved there by the uniform-cube argument.
nodes.title: KKL inequality with constant $2$ at $p = 1/2$

nodes.summary: The capped per-coordinate estimate under `μ_p` in the variable `u`, with `ρ² = A (1 - u)` and `A = 4p(1-p)`.

nodes.summary: At `p = 1/2` the damped variance is the variance.
